long_biography.plain_text:
Launching Al Arabiya and Shahid expanded Waleed bin Ibrahim Al Ibrahim’s MBC Group beyond general entertainment television. The news channel created an international Arabic competitor in 2003, while Shahid developed into the group’s principal streaming platform. Those businesses sit alongside its television, radio, production, talent-management and music operations.

Al Ibrahim studied business management and media at Portland State University before founding MBC in London. He later moved its headquarters to Dubai and then Riyadh, matching the company’s growth to its regional audience. He remains non-executive chairman and the largest private shareholder after MBC’s listing, while Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund now holds the controlling interest.
